about: The source of truth of the study's levels: per level the function the learner fixes, its correct versions and the broken ones (made by fixed faults), and reference tests that tell them apart. Made 2026-11-07 from the phase 5 corpus (evaluation/phase5) and the hand-written tests of reference_tests.py; see README.md.
rule: Every correct version (and every equivalent one: broken by a fault, but the level still passes it) passes every reference test of its function; every broken version fails at least one.

kinds.correct: beats its levels and every level before (the other functions in their reference version A)
kinds.equivalent: broken by a fault, but still beats its levels: the level cannot tell it from a correct one, so neither can the tests

program_shape: main: forever: <the newest function>(); each function handles its situation or calls the function of the level before (a priority chain: the simulator runs one motor block per frame)

faults.why: the two turns swapped
reads the light from above (LLIGHT) instead of the floor
turns the same way on and off the line
half the speed
drives straight when off the line
the condition negated: stops when nothing is ahead
nothing happens when no wall is ahead (the call of followLine is missing)
turns away instead of stopping
slows down instead of stopping
the threshold below what the light sensor ever reads (40 in a tunnel)
reads the floor (LINETRACKER) instead of the light from above
the comparison the wrong way round: drives straight in the light
curves in the dark instead of driving straight
nothing happens in the light (the call of stopAtWall is missing)
turns towards the wall: the turns swapped
reads FRONT instead of the first side sensor
the threshold below what the light sensor ever reads
nothing happens without a wall (the calls of driveInTheDark are missing)
the two turns swapped
the black threshold above the floor (83): it steers everywhere
reads the light from above instead of the floor
nothing happens off the line in the dark and in the light (the calls of avoidWalls are missing)

tests.name: Follows a straight line to its end within 20 s
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a straight line of 115 cm, when the program runs, then it reaches the goal at the line's end within 20 s (the time limit of L1).

tests.name: Follows a bend to the left
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line that bends to the left, when the program runs, then it follows the line round the bend to the goal at its end.

tests.name: Follows a bend to the right
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line that bends to the right, when the program runs, then it follows the line round the bend to the goal at its end.

tests.name: Stops in front of the wall and stays there
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line that runs into a wall, when the program runs for 30 s, then it stops in front of the wall (it ends in the area before it), never bumps into it, and stands still from 15 s on (it gets there in about 9 s; L4 wants it to stand still in front of the wall).

tests.name: With nothing ahead, follows the line
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line with nothing ahead, when the program runs, then it follows the line to the goal at its end.

tests.name: Follows the line into the tunnel and gets through the dark
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line that runs into a tunnel, when the program runs, then it drives on in the dark to the goal inside the tunnel without bumping into the tunnel's walls.

tests.name: In the dark, drives straight on
tests.scenario: Given the robot inside a dark tunnel with no line, when the program runs, then it drives straight on to the goal without bumping into the tunnel's walls.

driveInTheDark.name: In the light, a bend to the left

tests.name: In the light, still follows the line round a bend
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line in the light that bends to the left, when the program runs, then it follows the line round the bend to the goal (it drives straight only in the dark).

avoidWalls.name: A tunnel that bends to the right

tests.name: Turns away from the wall on its left and gets round the bend
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line into a tunnel that bends to the right, when the program runs, then in the dark it turns away from the tunnel's wall on its left and gets round the bend to the goal inside the tunnel without bumping into it.

avoidWalls.name: A tunnel that bends to the left

tests.name: Turns away from the wall on its right and gets round the bend
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line into a tunnel that bends to the left, when the program runs, then in the dark it turns away from the tunnel's wall on its right and gets round the bend to the goal inside the tunnel without bumping into it.

tests.name: Follows the line into the tunnel and gets through the dark
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line that runs into a tunnel, when the program runs, then it drives on in the dark to the goal inside the tunnel without bumping into the tunnel's walls.

followInTheDark.name: A line in the dark that bends to the right

tests.name: In the dark, follows the line round a bend to the right
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line inside a dark tunnel, when the line bends to the right, then the robot follows it to the goal at its end without bumping into the tunnel.

followInTheDark.name: A line in the dark that bends to the left

tests.name: In the dark, follows the line round a bend to the left
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line inside a dark tunnel, when the line bends to the left, then the robot follows it to the goal at its end without bumping into the tunnel.

tests.name: In the dark, drives straight on
tests.scenario: Given the robot inside a dark tunnel with no line, when the program runs, then it drives straight on to the goal without bumping into the tunnel's walls.

followInTheDark.name: A line out of the dark

tests.name: Follows the line out of the dark and on in the light
tests.scenario: Given the robot on a line inside a dark tunnel, when the line runs on out of the tunnel, then the robot follows it into the light and on to the goal at its end.
